sampling: For each growth-region target type: horizontal/vertical extrema and nearest centroid (deduplicated). Tutorial regions: every mapped travel point plus first/last story NPC. Expected pixels computed from independently fetched provider settings and nodes, not the site implementation.

independentGameReferences.method: SIFT terrain features + RANSAC similarity transform from native TH.GL image to downscaled historical KR game-map screenshot; selected source points projected into screenshot and visually inspected. Transform estimates terrain registration, not live marker truth.
independentGameReferences.orientation: Positive, nearly equal X/Y scale; negligible rotation; no reflection.

publicSnapshotNote: Fetched public files over validated HTTP TLS. Local Chromium direct public navigation failed due to environment network/certificate setup; behavior tested against source/local copies and public-snapshot JS after SHA comparison. This is not a claim of an end-to-end remote-browser session.

confirmedBugs.before: Scale did not change; only a single pointer drag was tracked.
confirmedBugs.fix: Track active pointers; zoom about gesture midpoint; rebase when a finger leaves; cancel cleanly.

confirmedBugs.trigger: Open a shared point link or resize the map viewport
confirmedBugs.before: ResizeObserver(fit) undid the shared-point centering and reset the chosen view.
confirmedBugs.fix: Ignore initial unchanged-size observation; preserve the viewed world centre on viewport size changes.
